# cpp-jwt provenance

Upstream: https://github.com/arun11299/cpp-jwt
Revision: 4b66cf74e5ece16e7f7e8c3d8c0c63d01b4cc9aa
License: MIT; the unmodified upstream license is in LICENSE.

This is the revision formerly pinned by afv-native's extern/cpp-jwt submodule
and vendored by afv-native commit 244e457. The include/jwt headers are retained.
Precompiled Mach-O executables under include/jwt/test were removed; test sources
remain for reference. They are not part of the client build and must not be run
as part of client/package verification.
